cli.description: Open a Marklab workspace or document.
cli.afterHelp: Use --workspace for one directory or --file for one document. Named targets cannot be combined. Supply multiple positional paths to open them in separate windows. Relative paths use the calling process working directory. Use -- before paths beginning with a hyphen. The mcp subcommand starts the existing MCP stdio service instead of the desktop app.

args.name: paths
args.description: Existing files or directories to open in separate windows
